network_status.network: Rapporto evento 4-5 settembre 2024 - Valle di Susa
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPA Piemonte ricostruisce il flusso iperconcentrato e gli effetti lungo il Rio Gerardo, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata idrometrica evento-specifici. L'evidenza geomorfologica resta distinta da una misura idrometrica assente.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPA Piemonte report reconstructs the hyperconcentrated flow and effects along Rio Gerardo but publishes no event-specific hydrometric stage or discharge. Geomorphological evidence remains distinct from an unavailable hydrometric measurement.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
